title: The Crate
description: A crate went down the arch. Oddvar wants whatever was in it brought back. Not the crate. The crate he can replace.

fetch.title: Bring back whatever is in the crate
fetch.objective: Go down the arch, find the crate, and bring Oddvar what was in it.
fetch.journal: Oddvar wants a crate that went down brought back. He wants whatever was in it, not the box.

returned.title: The disc
returned.journal: I brought Oddvar a pewter sun-disc out of the crate. He took it and said he'd have more when he had a line for it.
